title: Which house plant suits the room
checked: Every reachable state checked (10 states, 58 with their data, 103 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 10 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: No pet next to a plant that harms it
rules.says: A plant that is bad for cats and dogs never stays within reach of one: it goes up on a high shelf.
rules.path: Take away the plant is pet-safe guard and it breaks in 4 steps: yes, no, yes, a kitten comes.

rules.says: The flat has three rooms. The tree never picks a fourth plant.
rules.path: Take away the a room is left guard and it breaks in 15 steps: yes, yes, yes, next room, yes, yes, yes, next room, yes, yes, yes, next room, yes, yes, yes.
